title: A page item that cites another item's answer reads that item first, and the check refuses a cited date it cannot find
why: Incident 13:57 CST Nov 12: triage posted item 625 citing "your Nov 8 answer" for item 485; item 485 was posted Nov 10 and holds no answer. Fixed in place at 13:57 CST.
note: Fix: question-judge (or the page writer's check) resolves each cited item number or "your <date> answer" against the items collection and refuses a date or answer that does not match. Red first on item 625's first text. Kin: page-item-past-ruling.
